newsitem.title: USA: Noland says December sales fell 8.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Noland says December sales fell 8.5 pct.

text.p: Noland Co said on Tuesday its sales in December fell 8.5 percent to $32.4 million from the year-ago level.
It said it posted sales of $465.7 million for all of 1996, one percent below the record $469.5 million in 1995.
The December and the full-year sales figures are subject to year-end adjustments and final 1996 results will be reported in mid-February, it said.
Noland distributes plumbing, heating, electrical, air-conditioning, refrigeration products in 108 branches located in 15 states.
